name: FITTERS Diversified Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司完成出售全资子公司 Future NRG Sdn. Bhd.，交易对价 RM15,200,000，该公司自2026年3月26日起不再为子公司。其余公告主要为诉讼事项、财年变更及季度业绩，未披露其他业务板块的扩张、新业务或合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, the company completed the disposal of its wholly-owned subsidiary Future NRG Sdn. Bhd. for a total consideration of RM15,200,000, and FNRG ceased to be a subsidiary effective 26 March 2026. Other announcements mainly relate to litigation, change in financial year end and quarterly results, with no other information disclosed on expansion, new business or contracts for other segments.

segments.name: 可再生能源与废物转能源及绿色棕油厂
segments.name_en: Renewable and Waste-To-Energy and Green Palm Oil Mill
segments.note: 今年完成出售全资子公司 Future NRG Sdn. Bhd.，该公司不再为集团子公司。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of wholly-owned subsidiary Future NRG Sdn. Bhd. during the year, which ceased to be a subsidiary of the group.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 出售协议先决条件已满足，交易于2026年3月26日完成，FNRG 不再为全资子公司。
actions.text_en: Conditions precedent fulfilled and completion effective on 26 March 2026; FNRG ceased to be a wholly-owned subsidiary.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订股份出售协议，以 RM15,200,000 出售 Future NRG Sdn. Bhd. 全部 28,000,000 股普通股。
actions.text_en: Entered into share sale agreements to dispose of the entire 28,000,000 ordinary shares in Future NRG Sdn. Bhd. for RM15,200,000.
